direct_raw_page_findings.finding: The raw highlights page reports 6 of 38 reviewed contracts incorrectly recording waiver/exception information, and separate FPDS-NG limitations. The cited starting numeral 6 is correct. The sample does not establish complete federal performance or completion dates.

Raw printed page21 confirms DHS courses introduced in 2017, 94 percent training completion as of April2018, and December2017 acquisition-manual revisions. These are particular implementation acts/intervals, not governmentwide exhaustion of EO13788.

Raw printed page51 confirms PPM2017-12 dated September22,2017, immediate effectiveness, all VA contracting activities, and conditional continuation until incorporation into VAAR or VAAM or rescission. The header, date, purpose, applicability, effective-date, expiration, and visible action-required text were inspected. The page does not establish when a terminating condition later occurred or that EO13788 itself remained operative after its revocation.

Section3(a)-(c) expressly revokes EO13836, EO13837 and EO13839; section3(a) disbands the working group; section3(d) revokes the October11,2019 memorandum; section3(e) directs review of related agency actions. The signing date January22,2021 differs from January27 publication. Exact cited spans agree with these operative provisions.

Complete section1 expressly revokes EO13925 and EO13980 among other orders; section2 calls for consideration of rescission of implementing measures subject to applicable law, not automatic extinguishment of each implementing measure. Signing date May14,2021 differs from May19 publication. The 318–818 cited span stops before the listing of EO13980; that listing was independently read on the same raw page, rather than assumed from the truncated span.
